corrections.reason: Joining across the line break yields ከልዕልናቸው ('from their high station [he brought them down]'), parallel to ከሹመታቸው ሻራቸው in the next clause; the 1st-order horizontal bar on ከ was misread as 6th-order ክ.
The Ge'ez gloss on ኢየአምኖሙ is ኢያዐቀ ሎሙ ርእሶ ('he did not entrust/commit himself to them', from ዐቀ); the rounded loop of ዐ was misread as የ.
The Amharic distributive rendering of ለለ አሐዱ is አንዱንም አንዱን ('each and every one'); the initial glyph is 1st-order አ, misread as 6th-order እ.
